title: The Bully Who Insulted Mom's Biryani

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Lunch break. And Bruno was about to make the biggest mistake of his life.

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: Ohhhh, here we go. Smelly curry slop… again?

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: It's my mom's kacchi biryani, Bruno. She wakes up at five every morning to make it.

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: Five a.m… for THIS? She should've slept in and ordered a pizza.

lines.speaker: joy
lines.text: Bro… did he just insult your MOM?

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Joy, don't. Trust me. It's not worth it.

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: Aww, listen to curry boy. So brave. Walk. Away.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: But behind Bruno… a shadow appeared.

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: CURRY… BOY?

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: P-Principal Huda! I— I was just joking!

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: Joking. About a mother's cooking. In MY hallway.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And then came the sentence. The whole school still talks about it.

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: Tomorrow. Lunch break. You will eat that biryani. Every. Single. Grain.

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: That's— you can't— ma'am, that's CRUEL!

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: And you will say thank you… after every single bite.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The next day. One spoonful. Then another. And then…

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: This is… the best thing I have ever eaten in my life.

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: Louder, Bruno. Nix's mother is on speaker.

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: AUNTY, I'M SORRY! YOUR COOKING RAISED MY STANDARDS!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Worth it. Follow for part two — Bruno's coming to our house… for dinner.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Karma. Best served with rice.
